summary: Iteration 6: Verified saved simulations (POST/GET/DELETE /api/simulations), editable domicile profile (PATCH /api/profile) with project re-sort by city then province, and Twilio test-send (/api/whatsapp/status + /api/whatsapp/test). Backend: 10/10 pytest PASS in test_iteration6_features.py. Frontend Playwright: consumer /portal profile-domicile-card editable & saves; tab-riwayat lists saved sims; sim-save on project detail persists sim; sim-compare-panel appears when 2+ sims checked; sim-delete removes item. CRM /crm tab-wa shows wa-channel-status='WhatsApp aktif via Twilio', wa-test-box lets admin submit and shows a graceful toast on Twilio 422 trial error (no crash, no 500). Non-admin (developer) gets 403 on /api/whatsapp/test as required.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py delete_simulation & update_profile: ObjectId(sim_id/user_id) without try/except → invalid id string will raise bson.errors.InvalidId → 500. Wrap with try/except to return 400/404.

_domicile_score uses substring match on city (e.g. 'depok' in location string). If a project location contains city name as a substring inside another word this could false-positive; consider tokenizing. Not blocking with current seed data.

save_simulation stores full amortization schedule inside the sim doc — for 30-yr tenor that's 360 rows × ~5 fields. GET /api/simulations returns all sims including full schedules; can bloat payload once user has many sims. Consider trimming schedule from list endpoint and expose via GET /simulations/{id}.
whatsapp_test does not validate phone format; user typing invalid string still forwards to Twilio and gets 422. Consider basic E.164 regex validation.
PATCH /api/profile allows arbitrary user to change instansi and monthly_income without any verification workflow — acceptable for MVP but worth flagging.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (profile save, tabs, sim-save, riwayat listing, compare panel, delete, CRM wa-status + test-send toast)

seed_data_creation: Test creates + deletes a TEST_ labeled simulation per run. Profile city ends set at 'Bekasi' (matches seed reset). No permanent seed added.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Project detail route is /proyek/{id} (Indonesian, NOT /project/). Login token key is 'token'. Twilio is now enabled=true (trial); /api/whatsapp/test returns 200 with status:'failed'+error string for unverified numbers — this is expected. Delete simulation uses window.confirm() dialog on frontend — accept it in Playwright via page.on('dialog', d.accept()). Seed resets consumer city to Bekasi on backend restart; save profile with city=Depok to test re-sort putting Bumi ASN Residence first.
